values.zh-CN: `OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E` 是**类型构造子**（结构），字段为线性等距 $E\simeq_{\mathrm{li}}\mathbb{K}^{\iota}$；显式参数为 $\iota\ \mathbb{K}\ E$，没有“第四个参数 $b$”的谓词形式。由基且规范正交的族构造它请用相应构造子。
values.en: `OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E` is a **type constructor** (structure) whose field is the linear isometry $E\simeq_{\mathrm{li}}\mathbb{K}^{\iota}$; explicit parameters are $\iota\ \mathbb{K}\ E$. There is no predicate-on-a-fourth-argument-$b$ form; build one from a basis that is orthonormal via the corresponding constructor.
